Disclosed ingredients

What does a disclosed ingredient list mean?

A disclosed list names the ingredients inside compound mixes instead of showing only a trade name.

Each of the five product pages shows the current recipe-based ingredient list. It is marked as recipe-derived; the label on the actual pack remains the primary source for a purchased batch.

Where can I check a specific product?

Use its dedicated product page and check the physical pack.
